# Review of the sharp asymmetric bridging theorem

## Correctness
**PASS.** The domain is the coded language generated by positive-length run pairs \(0^r1^{kr}\). A bridge can be empty, and the length-\(m\), length-\(n\) maxima exist because the alphabet is finite. The proof gives a right completion of at most \(km\), a left completion of at most \(\lceil n/k\rceil+k-1\), and their concatenation as an admissible bridge. The construction handles zero-only words, one-only words, boundary-truncated first and last generators, and visible complete runs separately. For the explicit pair \(u=0^{m-1}1\), \(v=01^{kt}0^{n-kt-1}\), the closing ones after \(u\) and the zeros before the first ones of \(v\) occupy disjoint parts of any bridge; their forced lengths prove the lower bound, with a matching bridge. All quantifiers and small-parameter boundaries are spelled out. No finite experiment is substituted for the unlimited proof.

The independently constructed generator-cycle language checker tested all 6,234 admissible ordered word pairs for \(1\le k\le3\), \(1\le m,n\le5\), using the explicit constructive upper bridge. It checked 132 extremal witness instances and independently ruled out 13,901 shorter candidate bridges in small cases. The finite testing alone cannot certify the unlimited theorem.

## Originality
**PASS within the inspected scientific record; historical priority is provisional.** Reyes, arXiv:2611.10995v1, full 15-page primary text, proves the structure, synchronization and transitivity of the coded subsystem, a linear specification obstruction for the ambient family (Theorem 4.1), and a completion estimate for a different bounded-boundary decomposition (Lemma 6.5). The paper does not optimize over *all* ordered pairs of admissible words of independent lengths or state the two distinct sharp slopes. The publicly accessible *Complete three-family antidictionary of proportional-run coded shifts* proves the minimal forbidden language, not shortest-bridge extremal costs. General nonuniform-specification theory concerns gap properties and does not supply this parameter-dependent bridge profile. Abstract-level evidence for the 2023 foundational article provides no basis to conclude whole-paper noncoverage; the unavailable full text is a residual risk rather than invented negative evidence. Source comparisons consider definitions, implication strength, and the difference between the ambient and coded shifts, not just title overlap.

## Mathematical value
**PASS.** A quantified connecting-word cost is a natural dynamical refinement of failure of (weak) specification. The theorem determines the sharp asymptotic in *two independent lengths*, identifying different costs for a word that must be finished and one that must be started: \(k\) on the left versus \(1/k\) on the right. Explicit extremal cylinders give a usable lower certificate, and the constructive universal upper certificate yields a directly applicable gluing method. This is neither an arbitrary finite case nor a mere restatement of non-specification; the anisotropy and sharp two-variable leading term are the structural content. The finite exact value of the profile, older unindexed equivalents, and the larger frequency-shift language remain outside the claim.

Self-review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
